- Regression: C6 same-family behavior remains as accepted; all R/AC/T ids unchanged; section 6.1 write set equals the 14-file envelope and per-task file sets; no new dependency; Load/Save/LoadPrompts/SavePrompts/ensureReplaceable unchanged.
- Report advisory LOWs separately. Do not propose a new id or envelope widening.

Report severity (CRITICAL/HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW), file:line anchor and confidence per finding. End with exactly '### Recommendation' then APPROVE or REQUEST CHANGES.
